title: Public Sector Data Quality Commons
description: An open toolkit, portal and playbook to measure, report and improve data quality in the public sector with open standards, aligned to the Government Data Quality Framework, the data quality action plan guidance and the data asset management policy.
notes: Personal project, not an official GOV.UK service or endorsed standard; no public body owns or endorses it. Status at release: Prototype. Code is MIT; documentation and content are CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/); third-party data keeps its source's licence (docs/CONTENT-LICENCE.md).
